pages.text: The adventure track is tailored for combat, spell development, and wilderness exploration.

$(li)$(bold)Recruit Wizards$(): Hire battle mages at the $(l:wandscape:building/tavern_guide)Tavern$(/l) and train them at the $(l:wandscape:building/mage_hut_guide)Mage Hut$(/l).$(li)$(bold)Gear & Spell Tactics$(): Craft wands at the $(l:wandscape:building/crafting_guide)Crafting Station$(/l) and set spell triggers in $(l:wandscape:reference/strategy_guide)Tactics$(/l).$(li)$(bold)Wilderness Cleansing$(): Lead mage followers into hostile camps to claim rare elements.
pages.title: Progression
